title: Short: "The probe that never reaches the other side"

lines.text: Release a probe into an airless tunnel straight through the Earth.
With nothing in the way, it crosses in thirty-eight minutes, then pops out the far side.
That model has no air, no spin, and no friction on the walls.
lines.cue: caption: NO AIR. NO SPIN. NO FRICTION.

lines.text: Now add friction on the walls, and keep it small, a value the authors chose to keep the motion from stalling.
The first half of the fall still takes about nineteen and a half minutes.
It shoots past the middle and starts climbing toward the far side.
It swings back and forth, each swing a little shorter.
The friction is small next to the pull, but over a trip this long, small losses add up.
So where does the probe finally stop? The full video on our channel has the answer. Like and subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
